title: When crime happens (state-wide)
text: State-wide, crime peaks on Fri around 00:00. The early hours (midnight–06:00) account for 39% of incidents — the window to concentrate patrols.

title: Detection-risk model
text: NETRA's detection-risk model (gradient boosting, ROC-AUC 0.713) predicts which open cases will go undetected. Main drivers: crime type, offence gravity. Explainable and per-case.

title: Case-linkage blind test
text: In a blind test, NETRA recovered 5 of 5 secret serial-crime patterns it was never shown, at 96% precision, hidden among 1,500 real distractor FIRs. The patterns were authored independently of the model.

title: Ethics by design
text: NETRA excludes caste, religion and occupation from every model AND never renders them. It predicts places and patterns, never a person's guilt. Every score is explainable; a human is always in the loop.

title: Platform & scale
text: NETRA runs 100% on Zoho Catalyst (Web Client Hosting + Advanced I/O Function + Data Store), with 50,000 synthetic FIRs built on KSP's official FIR schema live in the Data Store. The Copilot's LLM is served sovereignly inside Catalyst — no data leaves the police cloud.
